description: The doors of one place, as mapped in OpenStreetMap and tied to the place on evidence. Pass `place_id`, the `id` that `geocode`, `nearby_places` or `places_in_view` return with `include_entrances: true` (e.g. "osm:w123:poi"). Each entrance carries `lon`/`lat`, `kind` (the OpenStreetMap `entrance=*` value: main, yes, entry, service, staircase, emergency, exit, home, garage or other), `wheelchair`, `access`, `door`, `level`, `ref` and `name` as mapped, `osm_id`, `source`, `confidence` (high, medium or low, grading how sure the TIE between door and place is) and `basis` (own_outline, stop_area, address_match or sole_occupant: what tied them). Every door is OpenStreetMap-mapped (`source: osm`); none is estimated today. An EMPTY LIST MEANS NO DOOR IS TIED TO THE PLACE, NOT THAT IT HAS NONE: most places have no entrance mapped, and a door in a building several places share is tied to none of them unless its address says which, so never tell a user a place has no entrance. `note` says why a list is empty and `label` says all this for relaying. A missing `wheelchair` tag is unknown, not step-free. To route to a door, pass the place to `route` as `arrive_at`. Unknown ids are an error; a deployment without an entrance index answers that it has none. Requires the MapMap gateway (GATEWAY_URL + GATEWAY_API_KEY); see /docs/entrances.

place_id.description:
A place id exactly as a place result reports it, e.g.
`osm:w123:poi`: the `id` that `geocode`, `nearby_places` and
`places_in_view` return when called with `include_entrances: true`.

name: place_entrances

PlaceEntrance.description:
One door of a place, as the gateway's `include=entrances` and
`GET /v1/places/{id}/entrances` list it.

Every door served today is a node mapped in OpenStreetMap and tied to
the place on evidence (`source: "osm"`); none is estimated. An empty
list of these means no door is tied to the place, never that the place
has no entrance.

basis.description:
What tied the door to the place: `own_outline`, `stop_area`,
`address_match` or `sole_occupant`.

confidence.description:
How sure the tie between this door and the place is: `high`,
`medium` or `low`. It grades the association, not the door.

ref.description: `ref` as mapped (a station exit number, a door letter).

source.description:
`osm` for a door mapped in OpenStreetMap. `estimated` is reserved
for a door MapMap would infer; none is served today.

wheelchair.description:
`wheelchair=*` as mapped (`yes`, `limited`, `no`, ...); absent when
the map does not say, which is not the same as step-free.

entrances.description:
The doors tied to the place. Empty means no door is tied to it,
which is common, never that it has no entrance.

entrances_index.description:
Whether this deployment has an entrance index: `loaded`,
`not-configured` or `failed`.

label.description: What the list is and is not. Pass it on with the doors.

lat.description: The place's own latitude, when the index has it.

lon.description: The place's own longitude, when the index has it.

name.description: The place's own name, when this deployment's place index has it.

note.description: Why the list is empty, when it is.

title: Entrances of a place
